content: I'm getting this error on the CI tests for a PR. Codex told me that I need to import Lake in MathlibTest/AssertImported.lean, which doesn't sound correct at all. Any help on this would be appreciated, thanks!
I see you modified lake-manifest.json which is almost always a mistake in regular PR. Try reverting that?

We're getting that error in nightly-testing as well (and would probably also get it for a lake update PR). As far as I know, this is caused by import-graph#173 because the assert_not_exists Lake.Workspace here is never resolved anymore since we don't import the necessary Lake module anywhere.

So there seem to be two possibilities:

  • remove the assert_not_exists; ImportGraphTest.NoAxioms would already catch it; although I'm not particularly a fan of the module name hardcoding going on in that file
  • import Lake inside of the relevant test

Robin Arnez said:

So there seem to be two possibilities:

  • remove the assert_not_exists; ImportGraphTest.NoAxioms would already catch it; although I'm not particularly a fan of the module name hardcoding going on in that file
  • import Lake inside of the relevant test

I went with the second option and that worked, thank you!

To be clear, this is not something you should do in your PR; you should revert the changes to lake-manifest.json (e.g. git restore -s upstream/master lake-manifest.json) and not use lake update for mathlib PRs. What I mean is those are the two options we have for fixing the lake update PR #44663.
Oh I see, sorry for misunderstanding. Thanks for your help

I've restored my lake-manifest.json file to match the version in mathlib, but now I'm getting this error when I run lake exe mk_all:

error: invalid environment extension, 'Lake.packageAttr' has already been used
uncaught exception: failed to load Lake workspace

This was actually my original problem which was "solved" the first time I made changes to the lake-manifest file. This was probably done through lake update because I never directly edited lake-manifest. Now that I've reverted those changes, I'm running into the error again.
